title: helenium acaule
intro: Helenium acaule, commonly known as St. John's-glove or sneezeweed, is a flowering plant belonging to the daisy family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. Its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help with wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of Helenium acaule include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including acting as a sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent.
